problems.source_evidence:
This study aims to develop a useful and efficient QIO for COP. Therefore, we extract the hunting search efficiency concept in JA into QIO to propose a hybrid quantum-inspired Jaguar algorithm (QJA), benefitting from the quantum advantage and the classical optimization method while effectively addressing the COP. ... The real-world portfolio optimization is implemented to test the efficacy of QJA with other QIO techniques.
...
The experiment shows that QJA can better address real-world financial portfolio optimization than other QIO techniques and be more efficient.
problems.explanation: The memo asserts that there are no explicit limitations of the QJA algorithm, its scalability, or its financial modeling assumptions beyond hardware context. The paper does not explicitly state that such limitations do not exist; it simply does not discuss them. Claiming the absence of explicit limitations slightly overstates what the text supports.
